intended_object: A helper that takes a morphism s : R ⊗ X₃ ⟶ R ⊗ X₂ of free R-modules (in the module category of a monoid object R) and returns its underlying morphism in D. Inferred from the docstring and from how the next declarations, `baseChangeSectionHom_g` and `baseChangeSplitting`, use it.
explanation: The body is just `Mod.Hom.hom s`. It takes the underlying morphism of a module morphism between the free modules `freeMod R S.X₃` and `freeMod R S.X₂`, and gives it a name and type that match the base-changed short complex. It adds no mathematical content of its own. It is an implementation step used to build `baseChangeSplitting`, the splitting of the base-changed sequence. Its only parameters are the morphism it acts on, so there is no generality to judge. Since it is not a mathematical object in its own right, neither faithfulness nor narrowness applies.
